issues.issue: Whether the decision to refuse the H&C application was unreasonable.
issues.applicant_position: The applicant argues the decision is unreasonable, turning positive factors into negatives and ignoring relevant evidence.
issues.respondent_position: The respondent argues the decision was reasonable, considering the applicant’s circumstances and evidence.
issues.result_text: The court found the decision unreasonable due to misapprehension of evidence and failure to consider relevant factors.
